paired_support: Frozen Stage70 daily means on exactly the same observed piste length in each native grid; no interpolation
difference_definition: OSHD minus SPASS, in metres under the approved SPASS unit assumption
descriptive_metrics: Within each retained group and fixed lag: equal-day paired means, mean and median difference, mean absolute difference, root mean square difference. Both models are estimates, not truth; these are discrepancies, not accuracy errors.
missing_policy: Finite paired daily means only; retain actual zeros. No geometry or no finite pair produces missing metrics with status, never an invented zero. Counts and common-support coverage published.
inference: No iid daily p-values/confidence intervals, no independent-cells or pooled network causal interpretation
